description: Overstroming - Overstromingsbeeld primaire keringen (2020) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze kaart geeft het overstroombaar gebied en maximale waterdieptes die kunnen optreden na een doorbraak van primaire waterkeringen weer. Primaire waterkeringen zijn dijken, dammen, duinen en kunstwerken die bescherming bieden tegen buitenwater. Buitenwater is water vanuit de grote rivieren, grote meren en de zee. De primaire keringen zijn vastgelegd en genormeerd in de Waterwet. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are klimaateffectatlas, overstroming, primaire-waterkeringen. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
